question: What powers over the three worlds does the worn armor grant in anger?
premises: The wearer can bewitch the three worlds.
The wearer can pulverize the three worlds in anger.
The destructive effect occurs in an instant.
inference: When worn, the armor enables one to bewitch or instantly pulverize the three worlds in anger.
plain_english: One can bewitch the three worlds, and in anger pulverize the three worlds in an instant.
